snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Epic of Remnant Pseudo-Singularity IV Now Available
snippet.description:
The shadow of witchcraft falls over a small town... The next chapter of "Fate/Grand Order: Epic of Remnant," Pseudo-Singularity IV: The Forbidden Advent Garden, Salem - Heretical Salem, is now available!

"It happened suddenly...without warning.

It snuffed out all the light of the land, and it enveloped an entire town under cover of night. Such a phenomenon could only be described as... darkness. The enormous, malicious magical energy emanating from within the darkness bears a strong resemblance to the shadow of one of the Demon Gods who attempted the Incineration of Humanity.

What will become of this heretical land when the causes of this evil are eradicated?"

For more information, please visit the official website: http://www.fate-go.us/salem/

For the latest tips, tricks, and contests, please follow the official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FateGO.USA/
